data_and_numbers.instruction: Use strictly for tabular data, metrics, and KPI readouts to ensure vertical alignment of numbers.

colors.instructions: NO gradients. NO purple. Use flat colors. Use semantic colors strictly for risk indicating. Primary actions should be a stark blue or white.

layouts.spacing: Dense. Use gap-4 or gap-6. Padding p-4 to p-6 inside panels.
layouts.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px border-border on all cards and grid items to create a 'Command Center' table-like structure. Remove radii (rounded-none) or use max rounded-sm (2px) to keep it brutalist/bank-grade.
layouts.hierarchy: Top-left hero indicator (PD Score / Health Score). Progressive disclosure for deep data.

components.surfaces: Flat Solid only. Absolutely NO glassmorphism. NO shadows. Bank grade data requires 100% opacity for precise legibility.
components.charts: Use Recharts. Use monochromatic tones for structural data, and semantic colors (Green/Yellow/Red) ONLY to indicate risk levels. Strip away gridlines.
components.data_tables: Dense rows. JetBrains mono for numbers. Right-align numeric columns.
components.badges: Square corners. 1px border. Background opacity 10% of semantic color, text 100% semantic color.

motion.interactions: Hover states must increase contrast (e.g., bg-zinc-800 to bg-zinc-700). 0.15s ease transitions. No bouncy physics.

visual_enhancers.textures: None. Keep it digitally pure and sterile.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (Duotone or Regular) - dense, precise, technical.
visual_enhancers.explainability_panels: SHAP-style reason codes should look like terminal output or precise logs. Monospace font for the feature names, standard font for the human-readable explanation.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for all text. Semantic colors on dark backgrounds must be checked for legibility.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

banker_avatar.description: Professional banker portrait for user profile

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Dark Theme default application.
Implement a dashboard with a sidebar navigation and a top header. Ensure the header has a solid background.
For the Borrower detail page, create a dense, metrics-heavy layout using a 12-column grid. The 12-month PD and MSME Health Score should be the largest, most prominent metrics.
Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric values, scores, and currency.
For the Explainable AI panel (Top 5 Risk/Strength Drivers), use a layout resembling technical logs (combining monospace feature names with standard font explanations).
Semantic colors MUST be used exactly as defined for the Green/Yellow/Amber/Red/Black grading system.
Use Recharts for the PD gauge, trend lines, and portfolio heatmap. Remove chart grid lines to maximize the data-to-ink ratio.
DO NOT use generic purple/blue gradients or glassmorphism. Stick to flat, solid backgrounds with sharp 1px borders.
Use Phosphor icons for all iconography.
Ensure all buttons and inputs have high-contrast focus and hover states.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive and data-display components.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY IF explicitly allowed by context. In this banking app, AVOID IT.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style. Here, use sharp (rounded-sm) buttons.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, lightbulb for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts (located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or .jsx).
